The case of the prosecution in nutshell is that an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. was preferred on 07.02.2000 and thereafter FIR was lodged at Police Station- Behta Gokul, District- Hardoi, against the appellants as Crime No.C-8/2000, under Sections 147/323/504/506 IPC and Section 3(1)(x) SC/ST Act 1989. The FIR indates that on 22.01.2000 at about 7 AM, the accused appellants namely Rajendra Singh, Narendra Singh and Virendra Singh, armed with Rifle, Gun, and Lathi-Danda, alongwith two other persons, who were not known to the informant, forcefully entered into the house of informant and they hurled abused and also made casteist remarks and assaulted the informant. The FIR also indicates that informant was taken on gun point, however, specific name has not been indicated. The FIR also indicates that on account of previous incident, in which sons of informant namely Krishna Murari and Anand Prakash were assaulted by Mattu Singh, Pappu Singh, and Pahari, sons of accused alongwith others and in regard to the same an FIR was lodged, the accused were forcing to enter into compromise. 5.
